decisions.reason: Having remained on the market after launch and fitting the firm's strategy for integrated, data-driven turnaround optimization, this software is more likely to be scaled than withdrawn.

As a connectivity module that strengthens the firm's apron systems integration and complements its installed base, it remains a sensible part of the portfolio despite being less central than flagship offers.
Apron equipment monitoring supports the firm's lifecycle service, maintenance, and analytics strengths, so it is likely to be retained as airports seek more automated operational oversight.
Because safety-critical tower and airside services are core to the firm's positioning and customer value proposition, the controller safety alert service is unlikely to be taken off the market soon.
